title: What is your cancellation policy?

post.title: What is your cancellation policy?
post.html: If you need to cancel your booking, please let us know as soon as possible by emailing victoria@blacohillcottages.co.uk. Depending on how close to your arrival date you cancel, you may lose your deposit. Make sure you let us know with plenty of time.

description: Let us know as soon as you can if you need to cancel. Depending on how close to arrival you cancel, you may lose your deposit.
